title: Weeks After Failed Drone Attack, Germany Points Finger at Russia
summary_full: The country said Moscow was behind an explosive-laden drone found near a Ukrainian plane at a German airport last month. President Vladimir Putin of Russia called the accusation “a grave mistake.”
